fields.label: Disabled
fields.description: A disabled role stays assigned to its users but gives them nothing: no permissions, no document access, no notifications or assignments through it.

fields.label: Site only
fields.description: Users whose roles are all site-only work on the website and don't get the workspace (/app). One role without this flag gives them the workspace.

fields.label: Home page
fields.description: Where users with this role land after signing in, e.g. /app/hrm or /cabinet. With several roles, the first one in the user's roles that has a home page wins.

fields.label: Permissions
fields.description: What users with this role may do beyond document rules: manage users, e-mail, backups… “Everything (*)” — all of it, as System Manager.

fields.label: Require two-factor authentication
fields.description: Users with this role must set up 2FA (TOTP) before they can sign in.

fields.label: Allowed sign-in IPs
fields.description: Users with this role can sign in only from these addresses or networks (e.g. 10.0.0.0/8), one per line. Empty — no restriction.
